question: In the Los Angeles City Employees' Retirement System (LACERS) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the lead actuary have?
expected_facts: At least 15 years of experience with major public employee retirement systems, including at least 3 years with California public pension fund clients similar to LACERS.
acceptance: Accept 15 total and three California years. Do not require credential details unrelated to the years asked.

prior_reviews.reason: This is a Boston Retirement System investment consulting RFP, not the LACERS actuarial RFP. Its five-year requirement applies to a lead investment consultant on the BRS account, not a lead actuary, and it provides no LACERS experience requirement.
quotes: BOSTON RETIREMENT SYSTEM (“BRS”) INVESTMENT CONSULTING SERVICES REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (“RFP”)
Does the prospective “lead Consultant” on the BRS account have at least five (5) years of experience advising systems of similar size and scope to BRS
